verdict: No side cleared the apps' break-even on both held-out slices
lines: 10,246 graded app legs from two full-board recordings (10-15 and 10-24), 4,005 of them with no sharp line.
Unders, Overs, our NBA and CFB models' side and the season-hit-rate picker were each scored per app and sport: none reached z 2 above break-even on both slices.
Closest: CFB PrizePicks Unders with no sharp line, 35-40 (46.7%) on 10-15 then 215-168 (56.1%) on 10-24, vs 55.0%.
PrizePicks' unanchored lines land Over 50.5% of the time: the apps do not shade the number when nobody prices it.
Unanchored lines move less before the start than anchored ones, not more.
